title: So matcha disappointment
text: So matcha disappointment. I bought this after reading a TON of reviews about different milk frothers/steamers so I could make at-home matcha lattes with oat milk. I settled on the Froth Labs frother/steamer after reading a blogger's post about this item and was initially so thrilled with it - but it stopped frothing and steaming the milk after a month. Instead, it just heated up the milk. I returned the item to Amazon, thinking this was probably just a one-off thing, and it was promptly replaced by another. Which just stopped working after 2 months. And then I started reading all the reviews by people having the same exact problem. Fortunately, Amazon refunded me the cost of it even though it was a week past its return-by date. Buyer beware! This is an expensive purchase for something that that might work for a couple of months - and I used mine just once per day, unplugging it every time between uses, and using exactly as instructed. *Sigh* now I am back on the hunt for a reliable frother/steamer.
